subject: DI03009021

body.en:
Definition

A hydro-electric station converts water hydraulic energy,associated with head and flow,into turbine shaft energy and then electrical energy.

Explanation and application

  • Gross head is the upstream-to-downstream water-level difference;net head is the useful turbine head after relevant hydraulic losses. Use net head in the power equation.
  • Water has potential/pressure energy before the runner;the turbine changes its momentum/pressure into shaft torque. An alternator converts shaft work by electromagnetic induction.
  • Head alone does not determine power:flow and efficiency also matter. Drought,silt,environmental releases and irrigation commitments can restrict generation.
Gross versus net head?

Net head deducts relevant hydraulic losses from gross head.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

જળવિદ્યુત સ્ટેશન head તથા flow સાથે સંકળાયેલી પાણીની hydraulic energyને turbine shaft energy અને પછી વિદ્યુત ઊર્જામાં ફેરવે છે.

સમજણ અને ઉપયોગ

  • Gross head upstream/downstream water-level difference છે;net head hydraulic losses બાદ turbineને મળતો ઉપયોગી head છે.Power equationમાં net head લો.
  • Runner પહેલાં પાણીમાં potential/pressure energy હોય;turbine momentum/pressure બદલી shaft torque આપે.Alternator electromagnetic inductionથી shaft workને વીજળીમાં ફેરવે.
  • માત્ર headથી power નક્કી નથાય;flow/efficiency પણ મહત્વનાં છે.Drought,silt,environmental releases/irrigation commitments generation મર્યાદિત કરે.
Gross/Net head ભેદ?

Gross headમાંથી relevant hydraulic losses બાદ net head મળે.

h.gu: Hydro power:મધ્યમ લંબાઈની Derivation તથા ઉદાહરણ

body.en:
Given and assumptions

Steady incompressible water,ρ=1000kg/m³,g=9.81m/s²,Q=12m³/s,net head H=45m,turbine-generator combined η=0.88.

Step-by-step solution

  1. In time Δt,water volume=QΔt and mass=ρQΔt.
  2. Available hydraulic energy=m g H=ρQΔt gH. Divide by Δt to obtain hydraulic power=ρgQH.
  3. Electrical output=P=ρgQHη.If efficiencies are separate,use η=ηtηg and include other declared losses consistently.
  4. P=1000×9.81×12×45×0.88=4661712W≈4.662MW.

Interpretation and check

Net head avoids counting hydraulic loss twice. Pumped storage consumes energy in pumping;it is energy storage,not a net energy source.
body.gu:
આપેલી માહિતી અને ધારણાઓ

Steady incompressible water,ρ=1000kg/m³,g=9.81m/s²,Q=12m³/s,net head H=45m,turbine-generator combined η=0.88.

ક્રમબદ્ધ ઉકેલ

  1. સમય Δtમાં water volume=QΔt તથા mass=ρQΔt.
  2. ઉપલબ્ધ hydraulic energy=m g H=ρQΔt gH.Δtથી ભાગતાં hydraulic power=ρgQH.
  3. Electrical output=P=ρgQHη.Efficiency અલગ હોય તો η=ηtηg લો અને declared losses consistent રાખો.
  4. P=1000×9.81×12×45×0.88=4661712W≈4.662MW.

અર્થ અને ચકાસણી

Net headથી hydraulic loss બેવાર ગણાતો નથી.Pumped storage pumpingમાં energy લે;તે energy storage છે,net source નહીં.

body.en:
Definition

A hydro classification groups stations by a stated criterion;head,water regulation and duty are separate criteria and should not be mixed as one list.

Explanation and application

  • By water regulation:run-of-river without significant pondage,run-of-river with pondage,and storage/reservoir stations. Pondage provides shorter-term regulation than major seasonal storage.
  • By head:high,medium and low head schemes. Numerical boundaries vary by textbook/convention;state the assigned convention rather than treating one threshold as universal.
  • By service:base-load,peak-load and pumped-storage duty. A reservoir plant can shift generation subject to water and grid constraints.
  • By arrangement:dam-toe,powerhouse supplied by tunnel/penstock,and diversion/canal schemes. Pumped storage may use reversible pump-turbines or separate machines.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Hydro classificationમાં નિર્ધારિત આધાર મુજબ stations વહેંચાય;head,water regulation અને duty અલગ આધાર છે,એક જ listમાં ભેળવવા નહીં.

સમજણ અને ઉપયોગ

  • Water regulation મુજબ:significant pondage વગરનું run-of-river,pondage સાથેનું run-of-river તથા storage/reservoir station. Pondageથી major seasonal storage કરતાં ટૂંકા સમયનું regulation મળે.
  • Head મુજબ:high,medium અને low head schemes. Numeric boundaries textbook/convention મુજબ બદલાય;એક threshold universal માનવાને બદલે assigned convention લખો.
  • Service મુજબ:base-load,peak-load અને pumped-storage duty. Reservoir plant water/grid constraints હેઠળ generation shift કરી શકે.
  • Arrangement મુજબ:dam-toe,tunnel/penstockથી supplied powerhouse તથા diversion/canal scheme. Pumped storageમાં reversible pump-turbine કે separate machines હોઈ શકે.

body.en:
Definition

Hydro constituents are the hydraulic structures,water turbine and electrical equipment required to control water and convert its energy safely.

Classification / representative type

  • Hydraulic structures→dam/intake/waterway;prime mover→turbine;electrical system→alternator,excitation,protection and transformer.

Construction — part and purpose

  1. Dam/reservoir provides head and storage where applicable;spillways safely bypass excess water without routing it through turbines.
  2. Intake gates and trash racks control entry and exclude large debris;desilting arrangements reduce abrasive particles.
  3. Head-race channels/tunnels and penstocks deliver water;surge tanks,where used,moderate pressure transients rather than generate electricity.
  4. Turbine runner,guide vanes/nozzle and governor convert hydraulic power and regulate flow;runner choice depends on head/flow.
  5. For reaction turbines,a draft tube recovers exit kinetic energy and conveys water to the tailrace;it is not used in the same way for a Pelton runner.
  6. Alternator,excitation,bearings,switchgear,protection and transformer convert shaft power and connect output under controlled synchronising conditions.

Working — sequence and reason

  1. Available water level and permitted releases establish operating head and flow;trash racks protect the intake.
  2. Water travels through the waterway and penstock;friction reduces gross head to effective net head.
  3. Nozzles or guide vanes direct flow onto the runner;change in momentum and pressure produces torque.
  4. Runner rotation drives the alternator;excitation establishes magnetic flux and induction produces AC.
  5. Water returns through the draft tube where applicable and the tailrace;the water is not consumed by conversion itself.
  6. Governor adjusts water input for load/frequency requirements while electrical protection and permitted dispatch govern grid output.

Applications

Renewable generation,rapid response and peak support where water/head and approvals permit.

Limitations and safety

Never enter waterways or operate gates,turbines or grid equipment for a student model. Water hammer,cavitation and inundation are engineering hazards.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Hydro constituents એટલે પાણી નિયંત્રિત કરીને energyનું સુરક્ષિત રૂપાંતર કરતા hydraulic structures,water turbine તથા electrical equipment.

વર્ગીકરણ / દર્શાવેલો પ્રકાર

  • Hydraulic structures→dam/intake/waterway;prime mover→turbine;electrical system→alternator,excitation,protection તથા transformer.

Construction — ભાગ અને તેનું કામ

  1. લાગુ પડે ત્યાં dam/reservoir head/storage આપે;spillway વધારાનું પાણી turbine સિવાયના માર્ગે કાઢે.
  2. Intake gates/trash racks entry નિયંત્રિત કરી મોટો કચરો રોકે;desilting abrasive particles ઘટાડે.
  3. Head-race channel/tunnel તથા penstock પાણી પહોંચાડે;surge tank હોય ત્યાં pressure transient ઘટાડે,વીજળી બનાવતું નથી.
  4. Turbine runner,guide vanes/nozzle તથા governor hydraulic power ફેરવે અને flow regulate કરે;runner selection head/flow મુજબ થાય.
  5. Reaction turbineમાં draft tube exit kinetic energy recover કરી tailrace સુધી પાણી મોકલે;Pelton runnerમાં આ જ રીતે નથી વપરાતી.
  6. Alternator,excitation,bearings,switchgear,protection/transformer shaft powerને ફેરવે અને controlled synchronisingથી output જોડે.

Working — ક્રમ અને કારણ

  1. Water level તથા permitted release operating head/flow નક્કી કરે;trash racks intake બચાવે.
  2. પાણી waterway/penstockમાં જાય;friction gross headને effective net head સુધી ઘટાડે.
  3. Nozzle/guide vanes runner પર flow દોરે;momentum/pressure ફેરફારથી torque મળે.
  4. Runner alternator ફેરવે;excitation magnetic flux બનાવે અને inductionથી AC મળે.
  5. લાગુ પડે ત્યાં draft tube/tailraceથી પાણી પરત જાય;energy conversion પોતે પાણી વાપરી નાખતું નથી.
  6. Governor load/frequency માટે water input ગોઠવે;electrical protection/permitted dispatch grid output નક્કી કરે.

ઉપયોગ

Water/head તથા approval મુજબ renewable generation,rapid response/peak support.

મર્યાદા અને સલામતી

Student model માટે waterwayમાં પ્રવેશ કે gates/turbines/grid equipment operation નહીં.Water hammer,cavitation તથા inundation engineering hazards છે.

body.en:
Definition

A head-based scheme arranges civil works and selects a turbine to suit available net head and flow rather than merely changing generator voltage.

Explanation and application

  • High head:water is conveyed through a comparatively long/high-pressure penstock from elevated storage or a forebay;Pelton impulse turbines are a typical choice at high head and lower flow. Nozzle converts head to jet velocity,buckets reverse the jet and transfer momentum.
  • Medium head:Francis reaction turbines are common. A spiral casing distributes water,guide vanes control flow and the runner extracts pressure/velocity energy before the draft tube.
  • Low head:large discharge is often handled by Kaplan/propeller or bulb arrangements near a dam or barrage. Axial-flow runner and suitable draft tube minimise losses;adjustable Kaplan blades broaden efficient operation.
  • Head bands overlap in practical selection;use turbine selection charts,specific speed,cavitation limits and project economics instead of rigid head-only rules.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Head-based scheme ઉપલબ્ધ net head/flow મુજબ civil works તથા turbine પસંદ કરે;માત્ર generator voltage બદલતું નથી.

સમજણ અને ઉપયોગ

  • High headમાં elevated storage/forebayથી comparatively long/high-pressure penstock પાણી લાવે;high head/lower flow માટે Pelton impulse turbine સામાન્ય છે.Nozzle headને jet velocityમાં ફેરવે,buckets jet વાળી momentum transfer કરે.
  • Medium headમાં Francis reaction turbine સામાન્ય છે.Spiral casing પાણી વહેંચે,guide vanes flow નિયંત્રિત કરે અને runner draft tube પહેલાં pressure/velocity energy લે.
  • Low headમાં dam/barrage પાસે Kaplan/propeller કે bulb arrangement મોટા discharge માટે હોય.Axial-flow runner/suitable draft tube losses ઘટાડે;adjustable Kaplan blades efficient operating range વધારે.
  • Practical selectionમાં head bands overlap થાય;rigid head-only ruleને બદલે turbine charts,specific speed,cavitation limits તથા economics જુઓ.

body.en:
Definition

A station capacity entry must distinguish main river-bed units,canal units and shared-project ownership from actual output at one instant.

Explanation and application

  • GSECL operator reference:Ukai main hydro4×75=300MW;Ukai left-bank canal2×2.5=5MW;Kadana main hydro4×60=240MW. These are separately identified installations.[1](https://www.gsecl.in/business/power-generation/)
  • Ukai uses the Tapi river and Kadana uses the Mahi. The cited page is historical;verify operating unit status and report date before calling a figure current.[1](https://www.gsecl.in/business/power-generation/)
  • Sardar Sarovar on the Narmada has river-bed6×200=1200MWand canal-head5×50=250MW,total1450MW. The NCAreference assigns power-benefit shares57%Madhya Pradesh,27%Maharashtra,16%Gujarat;whole-project nameplate is not Gujarat-owned output.[1](https://www.nca.gov.in/)

વ્યાખ્યા

Station capacityમાં main river-bed units,canal units/shared-project ownership તથા એક ક્ષણનું actual output અલગ રાખવા.

સમજણ અને ઉપયોગ

  • GSECL operator reference:Ukai main hydro4×75=300MW;Ukai left-bank canal2×2.5=5MW;Kadana main hydro4×60=240MW.આ અલગ ઓળખવાળી installations છે.[1](https://www.gsecl.in/business/power-generation/)
  • Ukai Tapi અને Kadana Mahi પર છે.Cited page historical છે;current કહેવાં પહેલાં operating unit status/report date તપાસો.[1](https://www.gsecl.in/business/power-generation/)
  • Narmada પર Sardar Sarovarમાં river-bed6×200=1200MW તથા canal-head5×50=250MW,total1450MW છે.NCA reference power-benefit shares57%Madhya Pradesh,27%Maharashtra,16%Gujarat આપે;whole-project nameplateને Gujarat-owned output નમાનો.[1](https://www.nca.gov.in/)

body.en:
Definition

A nuclear power station uses controlled nuclear fission heat to produce steam,which drives a turbine-generator to produce electricity.

Explanation and application

  • Nuclear binding-energy change releases heat mainly through energetic fission products;the reactor does not directly generate the station AC output.
  • The downstream turbine/condenser/generator resembles a steam thermal plant,but the heat source,barriers and safety systems differ fundamentally.
  • In an indirect-cycle reactor,a primary coolant transfers heat through a steam generator to a separate secondary steam circuit;BWR steam is produced in the reactor vessel.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Nuclear power station controlled nuclear fissionની ઉષ્માથી steam બનાવે,જે turbine-generator ચલાવી વીજળી ઉત્પન્ન કરે.

સમજણ અને ઉપયોગ

  • Nuclear binding-energy changeથી મુખ્યત્વે energetic fission products દ્વારા heat મળે;reactor stationનું AC output સીધું બનાવતું નથી.
  • Turbine/condenser/generator steam thermal plant જેવા હોય,પરંતુ heat source,barriers/safety systems મૂળભૂત રીતે અલગ છે.
  • Indirect-cycle reactorમાં primary coolant steam generator દ્વારા separate secondary circuitને heat આપે;BWRમાં steam reactor vesselમાં બને છે.

body.en:
Definition

Fission is splitting a heavy nucleus into lighter nuclei with energy and neutrons;fusion combines light nuclei into a heavier nucleus with an energy release for suitable reactions.

Explanation and application

  • A neutron-induced fission can emit more neutrons;their subsequent fissions form a chain reaction. Effective multiplication factor keff compares successive neutron generations including losses.
  • keff<1:subcritical;keff=1:critical steady chain;keff>1:supercritical rising neutron population. Critical means self-sustaining,not an accident by definition.
  • Moderator slows neutrons in thermal reactors;control absorbers and other engineered systems regulate reactivity. Delayed neutrons make normal power control practicable.
  • Commercial stations in this syllabus use fission;fusion needs extremely demanding confinement/temperature conditions and is not interchangeable with an operating fission station.
  • Mass-energy equivalence is E=Δmc²;the mass defect concerns total reactant/product mass-energy,not disappearance of the entire fuel mass.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Fission એટલે heavy nucleusનું હળવાં nucleiમાં વિભાજન સાથે energy/neutron release;fusion એટલે suitable reactionમાં light nucleiનું heavier nucleusમાં મિલન સાથે energy release.

સમજણ અને ઉપયોગ

  • Neutron-induced fissionથી વધુ neutrons મળે;તેમથી આગળ fissions થાય તે chain reaction છે.keff losses સહિત successive neutron generationsનો ગુણોત્તર છે.
  • keff<1:subcritical;keff=1:critical steady chain;keff>1:supercritical rising neutron population. Critical એટલે self-sustaining,વ્યાખ્યા મુજબ accident નહીં.
  • Thermal reactorમાં moderator neutrons ધીમા કરે;control absorbers/engineered systems reactivity regulate કરે.Delayed neutronsથી normal power control શક્ય બને.
  • Syllabusનાં commercial stations fission વાપરે;fusion માટે અત્યંત કઠિન confinement/temperature જોઈએ,operating fission stationનો સમાન વિકલ્પ નથી.
  • Mass-energy equivalence E=Δmc² છે;mass defect total reactant/product mass-energyનો છે,આખું fuel mass ગાયબ થતું નથી.

title.en: 2.8 Nuclear reactor:main elements and their functions

h.en: Nuclear reactor:main elements and their functions

body.en:
Definition

A reactor is an engineered assembly in which a controlled,self-sustaining fission chain reaction releases heat that is removed by a coolant.

Classification / representative type

  • Fuel,moderator where applicable,coolant,control/shutdown systems,pressure boundary,shielding and containment have distinct roles.

Construction — part and purpose

  1. Fuel pellets/elements contain fissile material;cladding separates fuel from coolant and helps retain fission products.
  2. A moderator such as light/heavy water slows neutrons in thermal reactors. Fast reactors intentionally do not use a neutron-slowing moderator.
  3. Coolant removes core heat;it may or may not also be the moderator. The two terms describe functions,not automatically separate materials.
  4. Control absorbers regulate reactivity and independent shutdown provisions terminate the chain reaction;shutdown does not eliminate decay heat.
  5. Vessel or pressure tubes and associated piping form the pressure boundary;design depends on reactor type.
  6. Shielding limits radiation exposure;containment confines radioactive releases under design conditions. Monitoring,emergency cooling and dependable supplies provide defence in depth.

Working — sequence and reason

  1. Approved fuel geometry and reactor conditions support the designed neutron population.
  2. Controlled fission releases heat inside the fuel;cladding and coolant transfer this heat away.
  3. The coolant transports heat to the steam system,by a separate exchanger or direct boiling according to reactor type.
  4. Control systems maintain permitted power and protective systems respond to abnormal conditions.
  5. Following shutdown,decay heat from radioactive products still requires reliable cooling and monitoring.
  6. Engineered barriers and authorised operating procedures limit exposure and releases throughout operation,shutdown and fuel handling.

Applications

Controlled heat source for large-scale generation and specialised research reactors with different missions.

Limitations and safety

No reactor manipulation,radioactive material handling or fuel demonstrations by students. Use diagrams/nonradioactive models only.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Reactor એવી engineered assembly છે જેમાં controlled,self-sustaining fission chain reaction heat આપે અને coolant તે દૂર કરે.

વર્ગીકરણ / દર્શાવેલો પ્રકાર

  • Fuel,લાગુ પડે ત્યાં moderator,coolant,control/shutdown systems,pressure boundary,shielding/containmentના roles અલગ છે.

Construction — ભાગ અને તેનું કામ

  1. Fuel pellets/elementsમાં fissile material હોય;cladding fuel/coolant અલગ રાખી fission products રોકવામાં મદદ કરે.
  2. Light/heavy water જેવા moderator thermal reactorમાં neutrons ધીમા કરે;fast reactorમાં neutron-slowing moderator ઇરાદાપૂર્વક નથી હોતો.
  3. Coolant core heat કાઢે;તે moderator પણ હોઈ શકે કે નહીં.આ terms functions બતાવે છે,હંમેશાં separate materials નહીં.
  4. Control absorbers reactivity regulate કરે;independent shutdown chain reaction બંધ કરે.Shutdownથી decay heat દૂર થતી નથી.
  5. Vessel કે pressure tubes તથા piping pressure boundary બનાવે;design reactor type મુજબ બદલાય.
  6. Shielding radiation exposure ઘટાડે;containment design conditionsમાં radioactive release રોકે.Monitoring,emergency cooling/dependable supply defence in depth આપે.

Working — ક્રમ અને કારણ

  1. Approved fuel geometry/reactor conditions designed neutron populationને support કરે.
  2. Controlled fission fuelમાં heat આપે;cladding/coolant heat બહાર લઈ જાય.
  3. Reactor type મુજબ coolant separate exchanger કે direct boilingથી steam systemને heat આપે.
  4. Controls permitted power જાળવે અને protection abnormal conditionsને respond કરે.
  5. Shutdown બાદ radioactive productsની decay heat માટે reliable cooling/monitoring હજી જરૂરી છે.
  6. Engineered barriers/authorised procedures operation,shutdown/fuel handlingમાં exposure/releases મર્યાદિત કરે.

ઉપયોગ

Large-scale generation તથા અલગ missionવાળા specialised research reactor માટે controlled heat source.

મર્યાદા અને સલામતી

વિદ્યાર્થીઓ reactor manipulation,radioactive material handling કે fuel demonstration નકરે.માત્ર diagrams/nonradioactive models વાપરો.

body.en:
Definition

A reactor type is characterised by neutron spectrum,moderator,coolant,fuel and core/pressure arrangement,not by station capacity alone.

Explanation and application

  • PWR:light water moderates and cools the core. Primary water is kept pressurised;heat crosses a steam generator into a separate steam loop. BWR:light water boils in the reactor vessel and reactor steam drives the turbine.
  • PHWR:heavy water provides moderation and commonly primary cooling;pressure tubes contain fuel channels. Natural uranium can be used in typical Indian PHWRs;the secondary steam loop is separate.
  • Gas-cooled reactors use a gas coolant and generally a solid moderator in thermal designs;the exact fuel and pressure arrangement depend on the design.
  • Fast breeder reactors use fast neutrons,no moderating medium and commonly liquid-metal coolant. They can breed fissile material from fertile material;breeding does not remove radioactive waste/safety requirements.
  • For comparison tabulate moderator,coolant,steam-generation location,fuel concept and pressure boundary. Do not state all reactors use heavy water or all nuclear stations have the same circuit.

વ્યાખ્યા

Reactor type neutron spectrum,moderator,coolant,fuel/core-pressure arrangementથી ઓળખાય,માત્ર station capacityથી નહીં.

સમજણ અને ઉપયોગ

  • PWRમાં light water moderator/coolant છે;pressurised primary water steam generatorથી separate steam loopને heat આપે.BWRમાં reactor vesselનું light water ઉકળે અને તે steam turbine ચલાવે.
  • PHWRમાં heavy water moderation/સામાન્ય primary cooling આપે;pressure tubesમાં fuel channels હોય.Typical Indian PHWRમાં natural uranium વાપરી શકાય;secondary steam loop અલગ છે.
  • Gas-cooled reactor gas coolant તથા thermal designsમાં સામાન્ય solid moderator વાપરે;ચોક્કસ fuel/pressure arrangement design પર આધારિત છે.
  • Fast breeder reactor fast neutrons,no moderator તથા સામાન્ય liquid-metal coolant વાપરે.Fertile materialમાંથી fissile material breed કરી શકે;તેથી radioactive waste/safety requirements દૂર થતી નથી.
  • Comparisonમાં moderator,coolant,steam-generation location,fuel concept/pressure boundary લખો.બધા reactors heavy water વાપરે કે સમાન circuit ધરાવે એવું નલખો.

body.en:
Definition

Pressurised light-water thermal reactor with an indirect steam cycle.

Classification / representative type

Pressurised light-water thermal reactor with an indirect steam cycle.

Construction — part and purpose

  1. Vessel contains fuel assemblies and control absorbers;light water provides cooling and moderation.
  2. Pressuriser maintains primary pressure to suppress bulk boiling under normal design conditions.
  3. Primary pump circulates coolant through the core and steam-generator primary tubes.
  4. Steam generator separates primary water from secondary feedwater;secondary steam feeds the turbine.
  5. Containment,shielding and engineered cooling/shutdown systems surround/support the nuclear island.

Working — sequence and reason

  1. Fission heats core fuel;primary water removes heat without intended bulk boiling.
  2. Hot primary coolant transfers heat across steam-generator tubes and returns by pump to the core.
  3. Secondary water boils;steam expands through the turbine and drives the alternator.
  4. Condenser/feed equipment closes the secondary loop;external cooling removes rejected heat separately.
  5. Reactivity and pressure controls maintain permitted conditions;shutdown still requires decay-heat removal.

Safety and scope

Functional explanation only;no reactor-operation instructions or radioactive materials.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Pressurised light-water thermal reactor,indirect steam cycle સાથે.

વર્ગીકરણ / દર્શાવેલો પ્રકાર

Pressurised light-water thermal reactor,indirect steam cycle સાથે.

Construction — ભાગ અને તેનું કામ

  1. Vesselમાં fuel assemblies/control absorbers હોય;light water cooling/moderation આપે.
  2. Pressuriser primary pressure જાળવી normal designમાં bulk boiling અટકાવે.
  3. Primary pump core તથા steam-generator primary tubesમાં coolant ફેરવે.
  4. Steam generator primary water/secondary feedwater અલગ રાખે;secondary steam turbineને મળે.
  5. Containment,shielding તથા engineered cooling/shutdown systems nuclear islandને support કરે.

Working — ક્રમ અને કારણ

  1. Fission core fuel ગરમ કરે;primary water intended bulk boiling વિના heat કાઢે.
  2. Hot primary coolant steam-generator tubesની દીવાલ મારફતે heat આપી pumpથી core પરત આવે.
  3. Secondary water ઉકળે;steam turbineમાં expand થઈ alternator ચલાવે.
  4. Condenser/feed equipment secondary loop પૂર્ણ કરે;external cooling rejected heat અલગ કાઢે.
  5. Reactivity/pressure controls permitted conditions રાખે;shutdown પછી પણ decay-heat removal જોઈએ.

સલામતી તથા Scope

માત્ર functional explanation;reactor-operation instructions/radioactive materials નહીં.

body.en:
Definition

Boiling light-water thermal reactor with a direct steam cycle.

Classification / representative type

Boiling light-water thermal reactor with a direct steam cycle.

Construction — part and purpose

  1. Vessel houses fuel,control provisions and light water serving as coolant/moderator.
  2. Core circulation and feedwater systems supply water through the heated fuel region.
  3. Steam separators/dryers above the core remove entrained water before steam enters the turbine line.
  4. Turbine,condenser and feedwater equipment form the direct reactor-steam circuit;there is no PWR-style intermediate steam generator.
  5. Containment,shielding,monitoring and emergency cooling address the reactor and radioactive steam-system hazards.

Working — sequence and reason

  1. Controlled fission heats water so part of it boils within the reactor vessel.
  2. Separators/dryers condition steam before routing it directly to the turbine.
  3. Steam expansion produces shaft work and alternator output.
  4. Exhaust steam condenses and feedwater returns to the vessel;separate cooling water removes condenser heat.
  5. Core power,water level,pressure and protective functions are controlled within licensed limits;decay heat remains after shutdown.

Safety and scope

Functional explanation only;no reactor-operation instructions or radioactive materials.

વ્યાખ્યા

Boiling light-water thermal reactor,direct steam cycle સાથે.

વર્ગીકરણ / દર્શાવેલો પ્રકાર

Boiling light-water thermal reactor,direct steam cycle સાથે.

  1. Vesselમાં fuel,control provisions તથા coolant/moderator light water હોય.
  2. Core circulation/feedwater systems heated fuel regionમાં water પહોંચાડે.
  3. Core ઉપર separators/dryers steam turbine lineમાં જાય તે પહેલાં entrained water કાઢે.
  4. Turbine,condenser/feedwater direct reactor-steam circuit બનાવે;PWR જેવી intermediate steam generator નથી.
  5. Containment,shielding,monitoring/emergency cooling reactor તથા radioactive steam-system hazards માટે છે.

Working — ક્રમ અને કારણ

  1. Controlled fission water ગરમ કરે;તેનો ભાગ reactor vesselમાં ઉકળે.
  2. Separators/dryers steamને સીધું turbine મોકલતાં પહેલાં condition કરે.
  3. Steam expansion shaft work/alternator output આપે.
  4. Exhaust steam condense થાય/feedwater vessel પરત આવે;separate cooling water condenser heat કાઢે.
  5. Core power,water level,pressure/protection licensed limitsમાં control થાય;shutdown પછી decay heat રહે.

સલામતી તથા Scope

માત્ર functional explanation;reactor-operation instructions/radioactive materials નહીં.

body.en:
Definition

Pressurised heavy-water thermal reactor,typically with fuel channels in pressure tubes and a separate secondary steam cycle.

Classification / representative type

Pressurised heavy-water thermal reactor,typically with fuel channels in pressure tubes and a separate secondary steam cycle.

Construction — part and purpose

  1. Acalandria contains moderator around the fuel-channel arrangement;pressure tubes carry the fuel and pressurised heat-transport coolant.
  2. Heavy water has useful neutron-economy characteristics and serves moderation;typical Indian PHWRheat transport also uses heavy water.
  3. Fuel bundles occupy channels;the pressure-tube arrangement differs from a single light-water-reactor pressure vessel.
  4. Heat-transport pumps and steam generators connect the hot primary system to a separate secondary circuit without intended mixing.
  5. Control and independent shutdown systems,shielding,containment and engineered cooling provide different safety functions.

Working — sequence and reason

  1. Controlled fission releases heat in the fuel bundles;moderator supports the designed thermal-neutron reaction.
  2. Pressurised primary coolant carries heat from the channels to the steam generators.
  3. Secondary water receives heat and forms steam while the primary fluid returns to the reactor channels.
  4. Steam drives the turbine-generator and is condensed/returned through the secondary feedwater system.
  5. Power and protective systems control operation;fuel handling and cooling remain authorised plant activities,not model procedures.

Safety and scope

Functional explanation only;no reactor-operation instructions or radioactive materials.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Pressurised heavy-water thermal reactorમાં સામાન્ય fuel channels/pressure tubes તથા separate secondary steam cycle હોય.

વર્ગીકરણ / દર્શાવેલો પ્રકાર

Pressurised heavy-water thermal reactorમાં સામાન્ય fuel channels/pressure tubes તથા separate secondary steam cycle હોય.

Construction — ભાગ અને તેનું કામ

  1. Calandriaમાં fuel-channel આસપાસ moderator હોય;pressure tubes fuel તથા pressurised heat-transport coolant ધરાવે.
  2. Heavy waterની neutron economy ઉપયોગી છે/તે moderation આપે;typical Indian PHWR heat transportમાં પણ heavy water છે.
  3. Fuel bundles channelsમાં હોય;pressure-tube arrangement single light-water-reactor pressure vesselથી અલગ છે.
  4. Heat-transport pumps/steam generators hot primary systemને separate secondary circuit સાથે heat transferથી જોડે;intended mixing નહીં.
  5. Control/independent shutdown systems,shielding,containment/engineered coolingનાં safety roles અલગ છે.

Working — ક્રમ અને કારણ

  1. Controlled fission fuel bundlesમાં heat આપે;moderator designed thermal-neutron reactionને support કરે.
  2. Pressurised primary coolant channelsથી steam generators સુધી heat લઈ જાય.
  3. Secondary water heat લઈ steam બને;primary fluid reactor channelsમાં પરત જાય.
  4. Steam turbine-generator ચલાવે;secondary feedwater systemમાં condense થઈ પરત જાય.
  5. Power/protective systems operation સંભાળે;fuel handling/cooling authorised plant activities છે,model procedures નહીં.

સલામતી તથા Scope

માત્ર functional explanation;reactor-operation instructions/radioactive materials નહીં.

body.en:
Definition

A nuclear station schematic identifies heat transfer and electrical conversion paths while preserving the distinction between primary coolant,secondary steam and external cooling water.

Explanation and application

  • For the illustrated indirect cycle:reactor→primary coolant→steam generator→primary pump→reactor is the closed primary loop.
  • Secondary water receives heat in the steam generator;steam→turbine→condenser→feed pump→steam generator forms the secondary loop.
  • Cooling water takes condenser heat to a cooling tower/heat sink and is not drawn as primary radioactive coolant. No normal mixing is intended between these circuits.
  • The turbine drives the alternator;protected transformer/switchyard deliver power. The drawing is not a detailed P&ID or operating instruction and does not represent a BWRdirect steam circuit.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Nuclear schematic heat-transfer/electrical paths બતાવે અને primary coolant,secondary steam તથા external cooling waterનો ભેદ જાળવે.

સમજણ અને ઉપયોગ

  • દર્શાવેલા indirect cycleમાં reactor→primary coolant→steam generator→primary pump→reactor એ closed primary loop છે.
  • Secondary water steam generatorમાં heat લે;steam→turbine→condenser→feed pump→steam generator secondary loop છે.
  • Cooling water condenser heatને cooling tower/heat sink સુધી લઈ જાય;તે primary radioactive coolant નથી.Normal operationમાં આ circuits ભળવા માટે નથી.
  • Turbine alternator ચલાવે;protected transformer/switchyard power આપે.Drawing detailed P&ID/operating instruction નથી અને BWRનું direct steam circuit દર્શાવતું નથી.

body.en:
Definition

Radioactive waste is material with no further intended use that contains radionuclides above the relevant regulatory clearance criteria;management depends on activity,half-life,physical form and heat generation.

Explanation and application

  • Low/intermediate-level wastes may be segregated,treated,compacted,immobilised and placed in authorised engineered facilities according to acceptance criteria;ordinary municipal dumping is not an option.
  • Spent fuel is initially cooled and shielded under authorised storage arrangements. It contains reusable materials and highly radioactive fission products;it is not simply cold ash.
  • High-level reprocessing waste can be immobilised by vitrification,contained and stored with cooling/shielding;long-term isolation requires licensed engineered/geological provisions as applicable.
  • Dilution/discharge,transport and disposal are regulated activities,not student procedures. Minimise waste,maintain records and protect workers/public/environment under authorised controls.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Radioactive waste એટલે આગળ ઉપયોગનો ઇરાદો ન હોય તથા relevant regulatory clearance criteriaથી વધુ radionuclides ધરાવતું material;management activity,half-life,physical form/heat generation મુજબ થાય.

સમજણ અને ઉપયોગ

  • Low/intermediate-level wastesને acceptance criteria મુજબ segregate,treat,compact,immobilise કરી authorised engineered facilityમાં મૂકી શકાય;ordinary municipal dumping વિકલ્પ નથી.
  • Spent fuelને authorised storageમાં શરૂઆતમાં cool/shield કરાય.તેમાં reusable materials તથા highly radioactive fission products હોય;તે માત્ર ઠંડી ash નથી.
  • High-level reprocessing waste vitrificationથી immobilise કરી contain/store અને cooling/shielding આપી શકાય;long-term isolation માટે લાગુ licensed engineered/geological provisions જરૂરી.
  • Dilution/discharge,transport/disposal regulated activities છે,student procedure નહીં.Waste minimisation,records તથા authorised controlsથી workers/public/environmentનું રક્ષણ થાય.

body.en:
Definition

Nuclear generation assessment includes fuel energy density,reliable output,safety,waste and lifecycle costs,not only absence of a coal chimney.

Explanation and application

  • Advantages:very high fuel energy density,low direct operational CO2 emissions,small fuel volume and potential for sustained large output independent of daily sun/wind.
  • Fuel transport volume is small relative to coal,but specialised fuel fabrication,security,licensing and supply arrangements are essential.
  • Limitations:high capital cost,long development,complex safety/security obligations,cooling needs,radioactive waste and eventual decommissioning.
  • Low operational carbon does not mean zero lifecycle environmental impact;routine emissions,accident prevention and emergency preparedness require rigorous controls.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Nuclear generation assessmentમાં fuel energy density,reliable output,safety,waste/lifecycle cost આવે,માત્ર coal chimneyનો અભાવ નહીં.

સમજણ અને ઉપયોગ

  • ફાયદા:અતિ ઊંચી fuel energy density,low direct operational CO2 emissions,નાનું fuel volume તથા daily sun/windથી સ્વતંત્ર sustained large outputની ક્ષમતા.
  • Coal કરતાં fuel transport volume ઓછું છે,પરંતુ specialised fabrication,security,licensing/supply જરૂરી છે.
  • મર્યાદા:ઊંચો capital cost,long development,complex safety/security,cooling,radioactive waste તથા decommissioning.
  • Low operational carbon એટલે zero lifecycle environmental impact નહીં;routine emissions,accident prevention/emergency preparedness માટે rigorous controls જરૂરી.

q.en: Does shutdown remove all reactor heat?

a.en: No;radioactive decay heat continues and cooling is still required.

a.en: No;moderator slows neutrons,absorber removes neutrons to control reactivity.

a.en: PWRhas a separate secondary steam loop;BWRproduces turbine steam in the vessel.

a.en: No;it shifts energy and loses some energy over the pumping/generation cycle.
